docs.title: Structured output
docs.text:
Structured output allows agents to return data in a specific, predictable format. Instead of parsing natural language responses, you get structured data in the form of JSON objects, Pydantic models, or dataclasses that your application can directly use.

LangChain's create_agent handles structured output automatically. The user sets their desired structured output schema, and when the model generates the structured data, it's captured, validated, and returned in the 'structured_response' key of the agent's state.

```python theme={null} def create_agent( ... response_format: Union[ ToolStrategy[StructuredResponseT], ProviderStrategy[StructuredResponseT], type[StructuredResponseT], ] 

## Response Format

Controls how the agent returns structured data:

* **`ToolStrategy[StructuredResponseT]`**: Uses tool calling for structured output
* **`ProviderStrategy[StructuredResponseT]`**: Uses provider-native structured output
* **`type[StructuredResponseT]`**: Schema type - automatically selects best strategy based on model capabilities
* **`None`**: No structured output

When a schema type is provided directly, LangChain automatically chooses:

* `ProviderStrategy` for models supporting native structured output (e.g. [OpenAI](/oss/python/integrations/providers/openai), [Grok](/oss/python/integrations/providers/xai))
* `ToolStrategy` for all other models

The structured response is returned in the `structured_response` key of the agent's final state.

## Provider strategy

Some model providers support structured output natively through their APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Grok, Gemini). This is the most reliable method when available.

To use this strategy, configure a `ProviderStrategy`:

```python  theme={null}
class ProviderStrategy(Generic[SchemaT]):
    schema: type[SchemaT]

The schema defining the structured output format. Supports:

  • Pydantic models: BaseModel subclasses with field validation
  • Dataclasses: Python dataclasses with type annotations
  • TypedDict: Typed dictionary classes
  • JSON Schema: Dictionary with JSON schema specification

LangChain automatically uses ProviderStrategy when you pass a schema type directly to create_agent.response_format and the model supports native structured output:

```python Pydantic Model theme={null} from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from langchain.agents import create_agent

class ContactInfo(BaseModel): """Contact information for a person.""" name: str = Field(description="The name of the person") email: str = Field(description="The email address of the person") phone: str = Field(description="The phone number of the person")

agent = create_agent( model="gpt-5", tools=tools, response_format=ContactInfo # Auto-selects ProviderStrategy )

result = agent.invoke({ "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Extract contact info from: John Doe, john@example.com, (555) 123-4567"}] })

result["structured_response"] # ContactInfo(name='John Doe', email='john@example.com', phone='(555) 123-4567') 

```python Dataclass theme={null}
from dataclasses import dataclass
from langchain.agents import create_agent


@dataclass
class ContactInfo:
    """Contact information for a person."""
    name: str # The name of the person
    email: str # The email address of the person
    phone: str # The phone number of the person

agent = create_agent(
    model="gpt-5",
    tools=tools,
    response_format=ContactInfo  # Auto-selects ProviderStrategy
)

result = agent.invoke({
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Extract contact info from: John Doe, john@example.com, (555) 123-4567"}]
})

result["structured_response"]
# ContactInfo(name='John Doe', email='john@example.com', phone='(555) 123-4567')

```python TypedDict theme={null} from typing_extensions import TypedDict from langchain.agents import create_agent

class ContactInfo(TypedDict): """Contact information for a person.""" name: str # The name of the person email: str # The email address of the person phone: str # The phone number of the person

agent = create_agent( model="gpt-5", tools=tools, response_format=ContactInfo # Auto-selects ProviderStrategy )

result = agent.invoke({ "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Extract contact info from: John Doe, john@example.com, (555) 123-4567"}] })

result["structured_response"] # {'name': 'John Doe', 'email': 'john@example.com', 'phone': '(555) 123-4567'} 

```python JSON Schema theme={null}
from langchain.agents import create_agent


contact_info_schema = {
    "type": "object",
    "description": "Contact information for a person.",
    "properties": {
        "name": {"type": "string", "description": "The name of the person"},
        "email": {"type": "string", "description": "The email address of the person"},
        "phone": {"type": "string", "description": "The phone number of the person"}
    },
    "required": ["name", "email", "phone"]
}

agent = create_agent(
    model="gpt-5",
    tools=tools,
    response_format=ProviderStrategy(contact_info_schema)
)

result = agent.invoke({
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Extract contact info from: John Doe, john@example.com, (555) 123-4567"}]
})

result["structured_response"]
# {'name': 'John Doe', 'email': 'john@example.com', 'phone': '(555) 123-4567'}

Provider-native structured output provides high reliability and strict validation because the model provider enforces the schema. Use it when available.

If the provider natively supports structured output for your model choice, it is functionally equivalent to write response_format=ProductReview instead of response_format=ToolStrategy(ProductReview). In either case, if structured output is not supported, the agent will fall back to a tool calling strategy.

docs.title: Tool calling strategy
docs.text:
For models that don't support native structured output, LangChain uses tool calling to achieve the same result. This works with all models that support tool calling, which is most modern models.

To use this strategy, configure a ToolStrategy:

```python theme={null} class ToolStrategy(Generic[SchemaT]): schema: type[SchemaT] tool_message_content: str | None handle_errors: Union[ bool, str, type[Exception], tuple[type[Exception], ...], Callable[[Exception], str], ] 

<ParamField path="schema" required>
  The schema defining the structured output format. Supports:

  * **Pydantic models**: `BaseModel` subclasses with field validation
  * **Dataclasses**: Python dataclasses with type annotations
  * **TypedDict**: Typed dictionary classes
  * **JSON Schema**: Dictionary with JSON schema specification
  * **Union types**: Multiple schema options. The model will choose the most appropriate schema based on the context.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="tool_message_content">
  Custom content for the tool message returned when structured output is generated.
  If not provided, defaults to a message showing the structured response data.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="handle_errors">
  Error handling strategy for structured output validation failures. Defaults to `True`.

  * **`True`**: Catch all errors with default error template
  * **`str`**: Catch all errors with this custom message
  * **`type[Exception]`**: Only catch this exception type with default message
  * **`tuple[type[Exception], ...]`**: Only catch these exception types with default message
  * **`Callable[[Exception], str]`**: Custom function that returns error message
  * **`False`**: No retry, let exceptions propagate
</ParamField>

<CodeGroup>
  ```python Pydantic Model theme={null}
  from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
  from typing import Literal
  from langchain.agents import create_agent
  from langchain.agents.structured_output import ToolStrategy


  class ProductReview(BaseModel):
      """Analysis of a product review."""
      rating: int | None = Field(description="The rating of the product", ge=1, le=5)
      sentiment: Literal["positive", "negative"] = Field(description="The sentiment of the review")
      key_points: list[str] = Field(description="The key points of the review. Lowercase, 1-3 words each.")

  agent = create_agent(
      model="gpt-5",
      tools=tools,
      response_format=ToolStrategy(ProductReview)
  )

  result = agent.invoke({
      "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this review: 'Great product: 5 out of 5 stars. Fast shipping, but expensive'"}]
  })
  result["structured_response"]
  # ProductReview(rating=5, sentiment='positive', key_points=['fast shipping', 'expensive'])
  ```

  ```python Dataclass theme={null}
  from dataclasses import dataclass
  from typing import Literal
  from langchain.agents import create_agent
  from langchain.agents.structured_output import ToolStrategy


  @dataclass
  class ProductReview:
      """Analysis of a product review."""
      rating: int | None  # The rating of the product (1-5)
      sentiment: Literal["positive", "negative"]  # The sentiment of the review
      key_points: list[str]  # The key points of the review

  agent = create_agent(
      model="gpt-5",
      tools=tools,
      response_format=ToolStrategy(ProductReview)
  )

  result = agent.invoke({
      "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this review: 'Great product: 5 out of 5 stars. Fast shipping, but expensive'"}]
  })
  result["structured_response"]
  # ProductReview(rating=5, sentiment='positive', key_points=['fast shipping', 'expensive'])
  ```

  ```python TypedDict theme={null}
  from typing import Literal
  from typing_extensions import TypedDict
  from langchain.agents import create_agent
  from langchain.agents.structured_output import ToolStrategy


  class ProductReview(TypedDict):
      """Analysis of a product review."""
      rating: int | None  # The rating of the product (1-5)
      sentiment: Literal["positive", "negative"]  # The sentiment of the review
      key_points: list[str]  # The key points of the review

  agent = create_agent(
      model="gpt-5",
      tools=tools,
      response_format=ToolStrategy(ProductReview)
  )

  result = agent.invoke({
      "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this review: 'Great product: 5 out of 5 stars. Fast shipping, but expensive'"}]
  })
  result["structured_response"]
  # {'rating': 5, 'sentiment': 'positive', 'key_points': ['fast shipping', 'expensive']}
  ```

  ```python JSON Schema theme={null}
  from langchain.agents import create_agent
  from langchain.agents.structured_output import ToolStrategy


  product_review_schema = {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Analysis of a product review.",
      "properties": {
          "rating": {
              "type": ["integer", "null"],
              "description": "The rating of the product (1-5)",
              "minimum": 1,
              "maximum": 5
          },
          "sentiment": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": ["positive", "negative"],
              "description": "The sentiment of the review"
          },
          "key_points": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {"type": "string"},
              "description": "The key points of the review"
          }
      },
      "required": ["sentiment", "key_points"]
  }

  agent = create_agent(
      model="gpt-5",
      tools=tools,
      response_format=ToolStrategy(product_review_schema)
  )

  result = agent.invoke({
      "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this review: 'Great product: 5 out of 5 stars. Fast shipping, but expensive'"}]
  })
  result["structured_response"]
  # {'rating': 5, 'sentiment': 'positive', 'key_points': ['fast shipping', 'expensive']}
  ```

  ```python Union Types theme={null}
  from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
  from typing import Literal, Union
  from langchain.agents import create_agent
  from langchain.agents.structured_output import ToolStrategy


  class ProductReview(BaseModel):
      """Analysis of a product review."""
      rating: int | None = Field(description="The rating of the product", ge=1, le=5)
      sentiment: Literal["positive", "negative"] = Field(description="The sentiment of the review")
      key_points: list[str] = Field(description="The key points of the review. Lowercase, 1-3 words each.")

  class CustomerComplaint(BaseModel):
      """A customer complaint about a product or service."""
      issue_type: Literal["product", "service", "shipping", "billing"] = Field(description="The type of issue")
      severity: Literal["low", "medium", "high"] = Field(description="The severity of the complaint")
      description: str = Field(description="Brief description of the complaint")

  agent = create_agent(
      model="gpt-5",
      tools=tools,
      response_format=ToolStrategy(Union[ProductReview, CustomerComplaint])
  )

  result = agent.invoke({
      "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Analyze this review: 'Great product: 5 out of 5 stars. Fast shipping, but expensive'"}]
  })
  result["structured_response"]
  # ProductReview(rating=5, sentiment='positive', key_points=['fast shipping', 'expensive'])
  ```
</CodeGroup>

### Custom tool message content

The `tool_message_content` parameter allows you to customize the message that appears in the conversation history when structured output is generated:

```python  theme={null}
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal
from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain.agents.structured_output import ToolStrategy


class MeetingAction(BaseModel):
    """Action items extracted from a meeting transcript."""
    task: str = Field(description="The specific task to be completed")
    assignee: str = Field(description="Person responsible for the task")
    priority: Literal["low", "medium", "high"] = Field(description="Priority level")

agent = create_agent(
    model="gpt-5",
    tools=[],
    response_format=ToolStrategy(
        schema=MeetingAction,
        tool_message_content="Action item captured and added to meeting notes!"
    )
)

agent.invoke({
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "From our meeting: Sarah needs to update the project timeline as soon as possible"}]
})


================================ Human Message =================================

From our meeting: Sarah needs to update the project timeline as soon as possible
================================== Ai Message ==================================
Tool Calls:
  MeetingAction (call_1)
 Call ID: call_1
  Args:
    task: Update the project timeline
    assignee: Sarah
    priority: high
================================= Tool Message =================================
Name: MeetingAction

Action item captured and added to meeting notes!

Without tool_message_content, our final ToolMessage would be:

================================= Tool Message =================================
Name: MeetingAction

Returning structured response: {'task': 'update the project timeline', 'assignee': 'Sarah', 'priority': 'high'}

docs.title: Error handling
docs.text: Models can make mistakes when generating structured output via tool calling. LangChain provides intelligent retry mechanisms to handle these errors automatically.

docs.title: Multiple structured outputs error
docs.text:
When a model incorrectly calls multiple structured output tools, the agent provides error feedback in a ToolMessage and prompts the model to retry:

```python theme={null} from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from typing import Union from langchain.agents import create_agent from langchain.agents.structured_output import ToolStrategy

class ContactInfo(BaseModel): name: str = Field(description="Person's name") email: str = Field(description="Email address")

class EventDetails(BaseModel): event_name: str = Field(description="Name of the event") date: str = Field(description="Event date")

agent = create_agent( model="gpt-5", tools=[], response_format=ToolStrategy(Union[ContactInfo, EventDetails]) # Default: handle_errors=True )

agent.invoke({ "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Extract info: John Doe (john@email.com) is organizing Tech Conference on March 15th"}] })
================================ Human Message =================================

Extract info: John Doe (john@email.com) is organizing Tech Conference on March 15th None ================================== Ai Message ================================== Tool Calls: ContactInfo (call_1) Call ID: call_1 Args: name: John Doe email: john@email.com EventDetails (call_2) Call ID: call_2 Args: event_name: Tech Conference date: March 15th ================================= Tool Message ================================= Name: ContactInfo

Error: Model incorrectly returned multiple structured responses (ContactInfo, EventDetails) when only one is expected. Please fix your mistakes. ================================= Tool Message ================================= Name: EventDetails

Error: Model incorrectly returned multiple structured responses (ContactInfo, EventDetails) when only one is expected. Please fix your mistakes. ================================== Ai Message ================================== Tool Calls: ContactInfo (call_3) Call ID: call_3 Args: name: John Doe email: john@email.com ================================= Tool Message ================================= Name: ContactInfo

Returning structured response: {'name': 'John Doe', 'email': 'john@email.com'} 

#### Schema validation error

When structured output doesn't match the expected schema, the agent provides specific error feedback:

```python  theme={null}
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain.agents.structured_output import ToolStrategy


class ProductRating(BaseModel):
    rating: int | None = Field(description="Rating from 1-5", ge=1, le=5)
    comment: str = Field(description="Review comment")

agent = create_agent(
    model="gpt-5",
    tools=[],
    response_format=ToolStrategy(ProductRating),  # Default: handle_errors=True
    system_prompt="You are a helpful assistant that parses product reviews. Do not make any field or value up."
)

agent.invoke({
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Parse this: Amazing product, 10/10!"}]
})


================================ Human Message =================================

Parse this: Amazing product, 10/10!
================================== Ai Message ==================================
Tool Calls:
  ProductRating (call_1)
 Call ID: call_1
  Args:
    rating: 10
    comment: Amazing product
================================= Tool Message =================================
Name: ProductRating

Error: Failed to parse structured output for tool 'ProductRating': 1 validation error for ProductRating.rating
  Input should be less than or equal to 5 [type=less_than_equal, input_value=10, input_type=int].
 Please fix your mistakes.
================================== Ai Message ==================================
Tool Calls:
  ProductRating (call_2)
 Call ID: call_2
  Args:
    rating: 5
    comment: Amazing product
================================= Tool Message =================================
Name: ProductRating

Returning structured response: {'rating': 5, 'comment': 'Amazing product'}

docs.title: Error handling strategies
docs.text:
You can customize how errors are handled using the handle_errors parameter:

Custom error message:

```python theme={null} ToolStrategy( schema=ProductRating, handle_errors="Please provide a valid rating between 1-5 and include a comment." ) 

If `handle_errors` is a string, the agent will *always* prompt the model to re-try with a fixed tool message:
================================= Tool Message ================================= Name: ProductRating

Please provide a valid rating between 1-5 and include a comment. 

**Handle specific exceptions only:**

```python  theme={null}
ToolStrategy(
    schema=ProductRating,
    handle_errors=ValueError  # Only retry on ValueError, raise others
)

If handle_errors is an exception type, the agent will only retry (using the default error message) if the exception raised is the specified type. In all other cases, the exception will be raised.

Handle multiple exception types:

```python theme={null} ToolStrategy( schema=ProductRating, handle_errors=(ValueError, TypeError) # Retry on ValueError and TypeError ) 

If `handle_errors` is a tuple of exceptions, the agent will only retry (using the default error message) if the exception raised is one of the specified types. In all other cases, the exception will be raised.

**Custom error handler function:**

```python  theme={null}
def custom_error_handler(error: Exception) -> str:
    if isinstance(error, StructuredOutputValidationError):
        return "There was an issue with the format. Try again.
    elif isinstance(error, MultipleStructuredOutputsError):
        return "Multiple structured outputs were returned. Pick the most relevant one."
    else:
        return f"Error: {str(error)}"

ToolStrategy(
    schema=ToolStrategy(Union[ContactInfo, EventDetails]),
    handle_errors=custom_error_handler
)

On StructuredOutputValidationError:

================================= Tool Message =================================
Name: ToolStrategy

There was an issue with the format. Try again.

On MultipleStructuredOutputsError:

================================= Tool Message =================================
Name: ToolStrategy

Multiple structured outputs were returned. Pick the most relevant one.

On other errors:

================================= Tool Message =================================
Name: ToolStrategy

Error: <error message>

No error handling:

python theme={null} response_format = ToolStrategy( schema=ProductRating, handle_errors=False # All errors raised )

docs.title: Tools
docs.text: 时间 修订 2025-11-14 yixiu

docs.title: Tools
docs.text:
Many AI applications interact with users via natural language. However, some use cases require models to interface directly with external systems—such as APIs, databases, or file systems—using structured input.

Tools are components that agents call to perform actions. They extend model capabilities by letting them interact with the world through well-defined inputs and outputs. Tools encapsulate a callable function and its input schema. These can be passed to compatible chat models, allowing the model to decide whether to invoke a tool and with what arguments. In these scenarios, tool calling enables models to generate requests that conform to a specified input schema.

Server-side tool use \ Some chat models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini) feature built-in tools that are executed server-side, such as web search and code interpreters. Refer to the provider overview to learn how to access these tools with your specific chat model.

docs.title: Basic tool definition
docs.text:
The simplest way to create a tool is with the @tool decorator. By default, the function’s docstring becomes the tool’s description that helps the model understand when to use it:

from langchain.tools import tool

@tool
def search_database(query: str, limit: int = 10) -> str:
    """Search the customer database for records matching the query.

    Args:
        query: Search terms to look for
        limit: Maximum number of results to return
    """
    return f"Found {limit} results for '{query}'"

Type hints are required as they define the tool’s input schema. The docstring should be informative and concise to help the model understand the tool’s purpose.

docs.title: Custom tool name
docs.text:
By default, the tool name comes from the function name. Override it when you need something more descriptive:

@tool("web_search")  # Custom name
def search(query: str) -> str:
    """Search the web for information."""
    return f"Results for: {query}"

print(search.name)  # web_search

docs.title: Custom tool description
docs.text:
Override the auto-generated tool description for clearer model guidance:

@tool("calculator", description="Performs arithmetic calculations. Use this for any math problems.")
def calc(expression: str) -> str:
    """Evaluate mathematical expressions."""
    return str(eval(expression))

docs.title: Advanced schema definition
docs.text:
Define complex inputs with Pydantic models or JSON schemas:

## pydantic model
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class WeatherInput(BaseModel):
    """Input for weather queries."""
    location: str = Field(description="City name or coordinates")
    units: Literal["celsius", "fahrenheit"] = Field(
        default="celsius",
        description="Temperature unit preference"
    )
    include_forecast: bool = Field(
        default=False,
        description="Include 5-day forecast"
    )

@tool(args_schema=WeatherInput)
def get_weather(location: str, units: str = "celsius", include_forecast: bool = False) -> str:
    """Get current weather and optional forecast."""
    temp = 22 if units == "celsius" else 72
    result = f"Current weather in {location}: {temp} degrees {units[0].upper()}"
    if include_forecast:
        result += "\nNext 5 days: Sunny"
    return result

## json schema
weather_schema = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
        "location": {"type": "string"},
        "units": {"type": "string"},
        "include_forecast": {"type": "boolean"}
    },
    "required": ["location", "units", "include_forecast"]
}

@tool(args_schema=weather_schema)
def get_weather(location: str, units: str = "celsius", include_forecast: bool = False) -> str:
    """Get current weather and optional forecast."""
    temp = 22 if units == "celsius" else 72
    result = f"Current weather in {location}: {temp} degrees {units[0].upper()}"
    if include_forecast:
        result += "\nNext 5 days: Sunny"
    return result

docs.title: Accessing Context
docs.text:
Why this matters: \ Tools are most powerful when they can access agent state, runtime context, and long-term memory. This enables tools to make context-aware decisions, personalize responses, and maintain information across conversations. \ \ Runtime context provides a way to inject dependencies (like database connections, user IDs, or configuration) into your tools at runtime, making them more testable and reusable

Tools can access runtime information through the ToolRuntime parameter, which provides:

  • State - Mutable data that flows through execution (e.g., messages, counters, custom fields)
  • Context - Immutable configuration like user IDs, session details, or application-specific configuration
  • Store - Persistent long-term memory across conversations
  • Stream Writer - Stream custom updates as tools execute
  • Config - RunnableConfig for the execution
  • Tool Call ID - ID of the current tool call

```mermaid theme={null} graph LR %% Runtime Context subgraph "🔧 Tool Runtime Context" A[Tool Call] --> B[ToolRuntime] B --> C[State Access] B --> D[Context Access] B --> E[Store Access] B --> F[Stream Writer] end

end

docs.title: ToolRuntime
docs.text:
Use ToolRuntime to access all runtime information in a single parameter. Simply add runtime: ToolRuntime to your tool signature, and it will be automatically injected without being exposed to the LLM.

ToolRuntime: A unified parameter that provides tools access to state, context, store, streaming, config, and tool call ID. This replaces the older pattern of using separate InjectedState, InjectedStore, get_runtime, and InjectedToolCallId annotations. \ The runtime automatically provides these capabilities to your tool functions without you having to pass them explicitly or use global state.

docs.title: Accessing state:
docs.text: Tools can access the current graph state using ToolRuntime: ```python from langchain.tools import tool, ToolRuntime

docs.title: Access the current conversation state
docs.text: @tool def summarize_conversation( runtime: ToolRuntime ) -> str: """Summarize the conversation so far.""" messages = runtime.state["messages"] human_msgs = sum(1 for m in messages if m.class.name == "HumanMessage") ai_msgs = sum(1 for m in messages if m.class.name == "AIMessage") tool_msgs = sum(1 for m in messages if m.class.name == "ToolMessage") return f"Conversation has {human_msgs} user messages, {ai_msgs} AI responses, and {tool_msgs} tool results"

docs.title: Access custom state fields
docs.text:
@tool def get_user_preference( pref_name: str, runtime: ToolRuntime # ToolRuntime parameter is not visible to the model ) -> str: """Get a user preference value.""" preferences = runtime.state.get("user_preferences", {}) return preferences.get(pref_name, "Not set") ```

The tool_runtime parameter is hidden from the model. For the example above, the model only sees pref_name in the tool schema - tool_runtime is not included in the request.

docs.title: Updating state:
docs.text:
Use Command to update the agent’s state or control the graph’s execution flow:

from langgraph.types import Command
from langchain.messages import RemoveMessage
from langgraph.graph.message import REMOVE_ALL_MESSAGES
from langchain.tools import tool, ToolRuntime

# Update the conversation history by removing all messages
@tool
def clear_conversation() -> Command:
    """Clear the conversation history."""

    return Command(
        update={
            "messages": [RemoveMessage(id=REMOVE_ALL_MESSAGES)],
        }
    )

# Update the user_name in the agent state
@tool
def update_user_name(
    new_name: str,
    runtime: ToolRuntime
) -> Command:
    """Update the user's name."""
    return Command(update={"user_name": new_name})

docs.title: Context
docs.text:
Access immutable(不可变的) configuration and contextual data like user IDs, session details, or application-specific configuration through runtime.context.

Tools can access runtime context through ToolRuntime:

from dataclasses import dataclass
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain.tools import tool, ToolRuntime


USER_DATABASE = {
    "user123": {
        "name": "Alice Johnson",
        "account_type": "Premium",
        "balance": 5000,
        "email": "alice@example.com"
    },
    "user456": {
        "name": "Bob Smith",
        "account_type": "Standard",
        "balance": 1200,
        "email": "bob@example.com"
    }
}

@dataclass
class UserContext:
    user_id: str

@tool
def get_account_info(runtime: ToolRuntime[UserContext]) -> str:
    """Get the current user's account information."""
    user_id = runtime.context.user_id

    if user_id in USER_DATABASE:
        user = USER_DATABASE[user_id]
        return f"Account holder: {user['name']}\nType: {user['account_type']}\nBalance: ${user['balance']}"
    return "User not found"

model = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o")
agent = create_agent(
    model,
    tools=[get_account_info],
    context_schema=UserContext,
    system_prompt="You are a financial assistant."
)

result = agent.invoke(
    {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What's my current balance?"}]},
    context=UserContext(user_id="user123")
)

docs.title: Memory (Store)
docs.text:
Access persistent data across conversations using the store. The store is accessed via runtime.store and allows you to save and retrieve user-specific or application-specific data.

Tools can access and update the store through ToolRuntime:

from typing import Any
from langgraph.store.memory import InMemoryStore
from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain.tools import tool, ToolRuntime


# Access memory
@tool
def get_user_info(user_id: str, runtime: ToolRuntime) -> str:
    """Look up user info."""
    store = runtime.store
    user_info = store.get(("users",), user_id)
    return str(user_info.value) if user_info else "Unknown user"

# Update memory
@tool
def save_user_info(user_id: str, user_info: dict[str, Any], runtime: ToolRuntime) -> str:
    """Save user info."""
    store = runtime.store
    store.put(("users",), user_id, user_info)
    return "Successfully saved user info."

store = InMemoryStore()
agent = create_agent(
    model,
    tools=[get_user_info, save_user_info],
    store=store
)

# First session: save user info
agent.invoke({
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Save the following user: userid: abc123, name: Foo, age: 25, email: foo@langchain.dev"}]
})

# Second session: get user info
agent.invoke({
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Get user info for user with id 'abc123'"}]
})
# Here is the user info for user with ID "abc123":
# - Name: Foo
# - Age: 25
# - Email: foo@langchain.dev

docs.title: Stream Writer
docs.text:
Stream custom updates from tools as they execute using runtime.stream_writer. This is useful for providing real-time feedback to users about what a tool is doing.

from langchain.tools import tool, ToolRuntime

@tool
def get_weather(city: str, runtime: ToolRuntime) -> str:
    """Get weather for a given city."""
    writer = runtime.stream_writer

    # Stream custom updates as the tool executes
    writer(f"Looking up data for city: {city}")
    writer(f"Acquired data for city: {city}")

    return f"It's always sunny in {city}!"

If you use runtime.stream_writer inside your tool, the tool must be invoked within a LangGraph execution context. See Streaming for more details.

docs.text:
# 安装
pip install langgraph

# 最简单的图
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END
from typing import TypedDict

class State(TypedDict):
    value: int

def add_one(state: State) -> State:
    return {"value": state["value"] + 1}

graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("add_one", add_one)
graph.add_edge(START, "add_one")
graph.add_edge("add_one", END)
app = graph.compile()

print(app.invoke({"value": 0}))  # {'value': 1}

docs.title: 什么是 LangGraph？
docs.text: LangGraph 是 LangChain 团队推出的一个库，用于构建有状态的、多角色的应用程序。它基于图（Graph）的概念，让你能够清晰地定义和控制 AI 应用的执行流程。

docs.title: 核心思想
docs.text:
LangGraph 将应用程序建模为一个状态图（State Graph）：

┌─────────┐     ┌─────────┐     ┌─────────┐
│  Node A │ ──→ │  Node B │ ──→ │  Node C │
└─────────┘     └─────────┘     └─────────┘
     ↑                                  │
     └──────────────────────────────────┘
  • 节点（Nodes）：执行具体任务的函数（如调用 LLM、调用工具、处理数据）
  • 边（Edges）：定义节点之间的执行顺序
  • 状态（State）：在节点之间传递和共享的数据

docs.title: 传统 Chain 的局限
docs.text:
# LangChain Chain - 线性执行
chain = prompt | model | output_parser
result = chain.invoke({"question": "..."})

Chain 适合线性流程，但无法处理： - 循环（需要多次调用 LLM） - 条件分支（根据结果选择不同路径） - 多 Agent 协作（多个角色交替执行） - 需要记忆/状态的场景

docs.title: LangGraph 的优势
docs.text:
# LangGraph - 支持循环、分支、状态
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("agent", agent_node)
graph.add_node("tool", tool_node)
graph.add_conditional_edges("agent", should_continue)  # 条件分支
graph.add_edge("tool", "agent")  # 循环回 agent
app = graph.compile()

适用场景： - ✅ Agent（需要循环调用工具） - ✅ 多轮对话（需要维护对话状态） - ✅ 工作流引擎（复杂的业务流程） - ✅ 多 Agent 协作（多个角色配合）

docs.title: 安装
docs.text:
# 基础安装
pip install langgraph

# 推荐：同时安装 langchain 核心包
pip install langchain langchain-core langgraph

# 常用扩展
pip install langchain-openai  # OpenAI 模型
pip install langchain-anthropic  # Anthropic 模型
pip install langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite  # SQLite 检查点

docs.title: 第一个 LangGraph 应用
docs.text:
让我们从一个最简单的例子开始：

from typing import TypedDict
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END

# 1. 定义状态
class State(TypedDict):
    value: int

# 2. 定义节点函数
def add_one(state: State) -> State:
    print(f"Adding 1 to {state['value']}")
    return {"value": state["value"] + 1}

# 3. 创建图
graph = StateGraph(State)

# 4. 添加节点
graph.add_node("add_one", add_one)

# 5. 添加边
graph.add_edge(START, "add_one")
graph.add_edge("add_one", END)

# 6. 编译图
app = graph.compile()

# 7. 运行
result = app.invoke({"value": 0})
print(result)  # {'value': 1}

docs.title: 代码解析
docs.text:
1. 定义状态：使用 TypedDict 定义图的状态结构
  2. 定义节点：节点函数接收状态，返回状态更新
  3. 创建图：StateGraph(State) 创建状态图
  4. 添加节点：add_node(name, function) 注册节点
  5. 添加边：add_edge(from, to) 定义执行顺序
  6. 编译：compile() 准备执行
  7. 运行：invoke(input) 执行图

docs.title: 状态是如何更新的？
docs.text:
# 节点返回 {"value": 1}
# 状态从 {"value": 0} 变为 {"value": 1}

# 如果有多个键：
class State(TypedDict):
    value: int
    messages: list

# 节点返回 {"value": 5}
# 只会更新 value 键，messages 保持不变

关键理解：节点返回的是状态更新（State Update），不是完整状态。LangGraph 会自动合并更新。

docs.title: 可视化你的图
docs.text:
# 生成图的 PNG 图片
app.get_graph().draw_mermaid_png(output_file_path="graph.png")

# 或者获取 Mermaid 源码
print(app.get_graph().draw_mermaid())

Mermaid 输出示例： 

graph LR
    __start__ --> add_one
    add_one --> __end__

docs.title: StateGraph - 状态图
docs.text:
StateGraph 是 LangGraph 的核心类，用于定义有状态的应用流程。

from langgraph.graph import StateGraph
from typing import TypedDict

class State(TypedDict):
    messages: list
    count: int

# 创建图时必须指定状态类型
graph = StateGraph(State)

docs.title: StateGraph 的主要方法
docs.text: 方法 说明 示例 add_node(name, fn) 添加节点 graph.add_node("agent", agent_fn) add_edge(from, to) 添加普通边 graph.add_edge("A", "B") add_conditional_edges(source, condition) 添加条件边 graph.add_conditional_edges("agent", route) compile() 编译图 app = graph.compile() set_entry_point(node) 设置入口（旧 API） graph.set_entry_point("start")

docs.title: Node - 节点
docs.text: 节点是执行具体任务的函数。

docs.title: 节点函数的签名
docs.text:
from typing import TypedDict

class State(TypedDict):
    value: int
    messages: list

# 方式 1：接收完整 State
def my_node(state: State) -> State:
    return {"value": state["value"] + 1}

# 方式 2：只接收需要的字段（推荐）
def my_node(value: int) -> dict:
    return {"value": value + 1}

# 方式 3：返回部分更新
def my_node(state: State) -> dict:
    # 只返回需要更新的键
    return {"messages": state["messages"] + ["hello"]}

docs.title: 节点的最佳实践
docs.text:
# ✅ 好的做法：清晰的输入输出
def call_llm(messages: list) -> dict:
    response = model.invoke(messages)
    return {"messages": messages + [response]}

# ❌ 避免：副作用不明确
def call_llm(state):
    # 不要修改外部变量
    global_counter += 1  # ❌
    return {...}

docs.title: Edge - 边
docs.text: 边定义节点之间的执行顺序。

docs.title: 普通边（Normal Edge）
docs.text:
# A 执行完后总是执行 B
graph.add_edge("A", "B")

docs.title: 条件边（Conditional Edge）
docs.text:
from langgraph.graph import END

def route(state: State) -> str:
    if state["count"] > 10:
        return "high_node"
    else:
        return "low_node"

# 根据 route 函数的返回值决定下一步
graph.add_conditional_edges(
    source="counter",      # 从哪个节点出来
    condition=route,       # 路由函数
    mapping={              # 可选：返回值到节点名的映射
        "high_node": "high_node",
        "low_node": "low_node"
    }
)

docs.title: 特殊节点名
docs.text:
from langgraph.graph import START, END

# START：图的入口
graph.add_edge(START, "first_node")

# END：图的出口
graph.add_edge("last_node", END)

docs.title: State - 状态
docs.text: 状态是节点之间共享的数据。

docs.title: 定义状态
docs.text:
from typing import TypedDict, List
from langchain_core.messages import BaseMessage

# 方式 1：TypedDict（推荐）
class State(TypedDict):
    messages: List[BaseMessage]
    iteration: int

# 方式 2：dataclass
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class State:
    messages: List[BaseMessage] = field(default_factory=list)
    iteration: int = 0

docs.title: 状态更新机制
docs.text:
class State(TypedDict):
    a: int
    b: int
    c: int

# 初始状态：{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}

# 节点 1 返回 {"a": 10}
# 新状态：{"a": 10, "b": 2, "c": 3}  ← 只更新 a

# 节点 2 返回 {"b": 20, "c": 30}
# 新状态：{"a": 10, "b": 20, "c": 30}

关键理解：节点返回的是增量更新，不是完整状态替换。

docs.title: 完整示例：条件分支
docs.text:
from typing import TypedDict, Literal
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END, ConditionalEdges

class State(TypedDict):
    value: int

def start(state: State) -> State:
    print(f"Starting with value: {state['value']}")
    return state

def add(state: State) -> State:
    return {"value": state["value"] + 5}

def subtract(state: State) -> State:
    return {"value": state["value"] - 3}

def route(state: State) -> Literal["add", "subtract"]:
    if state["value"] > 10:
        return "subtract"
    else:
        return "add"

# 构建图
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("start", start)
graph.add_node("add", add)
graph.add_node("subtract", subtract)

graph.add_edge(START, "start")
graph.add_conditional_edges("start", route)
graph.add_edge("add", END)
graph.add_edge("subtract", END)

app = graph.compile()

# 测试
print(app.invoke({"value": 5}))    # value: 5 → add → 10
print(app.invoke({"value": 15}))   # value: 15 → subtract → 12

docs.title: 图的执行流程
docs.text:
1. invoke(input) 被调用
       ↓
2. 状态初始化为 input
       ↓
3. 从 START 开始，找到下一个节点
       ↓
4. 执行节点函数，获取状态更新
       ↓
5. 合并状态更新到当前状态
       ↓
6. 根据边找到下一个节点
       ↓
7. 重复 4-6，直到到达 END 或没有更多节点
       ↓
8. 返回最终状态

docs.title: 打印状态变化
docs.text:
def debug_node(state: State) -> State:
    print(f"📍 debug_node: {state}")
    return state

graph.add_node("debug", debug_node)

docs.title: 获取执行轨迹
docs.text:
# 使用 stream 模式查看每一步
for step in app.stream({"value": 0}):
    print(step)
# 输出：{'node_name': {'key': 'updated_value'}}

docs.title: 可视化图结构
docs.text:
# 打印 Mermaid 格式
print(app.get_graph().draw_mermaid())

# 保存为图片
app.get_graph().draw_mermaid_png(output_file_path="graph.png")

docs.title: ❌ 错误 1：节点返回 None
docs.text:
def bad_node(state: State) -> None:
    print("Doing something...")
    # 忘记返回状态更新！

# ✅ 修正
def good_node(state: State) -> dict:
    print("Doing something...")
    return {}  # 空更新也是有效的

docs.title: ❌ 错误 2：状态键不匹配
docs.text:
class State(TypedDict):
    value: int

def wrong_node(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"wrong_key": 123}  # 这个键不在 State 中！

# ✅ 修正
def right_node(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"value": 123}

docs.title: ❌ 错误 3：循环没有退出条件
docs.text:
# 这会导致无限循环！
graph.add_edge("A", "B")
graph.add_edge("B", "A")
# 没有条件边或最大迭代限制

# ✅ 修正：添加计数器
class State(TypedDict):
    count: int

def check_limit(state: State) -> str:
    if state["count"] >= 5:
        return "end"
    return "continue"

docs.title: Channel - 通道
docs.text: 在 LangGraph 中，Channel 是状态的基本组成单元。每个状态键对应一个 Channel。

docs.title: 默认 Channel 类型
docs.text:
当你使用 TypedDict 定义状态时，LangGraph 会自动为每个字段分配合适的 Channel：

from typing import TypedDict, List

class State(TypedDict):
    value: int              # → LastValue[int]
    messages: List[str]     # → LastValue[List[str]]

docs.title: 显式定义 Channel
docs.text:
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph
from langgraph.channels import LastValue, EphemeralValue, Topic

class State(TypedDict):
    # 普通值：记住最后一次写入
    value: int

    # 临时值：只在当前 step 有效
    temp: str

# 显式指定 Channel 类型
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_channel("value", LastValue(int))
graph.add_channel("temp", EphemeralValue(str))

docs.title: LastValue - 最后值
docs.text:
最常用的 Channel 类型。记住最后一次写入的值。

from langgraph.channels import LastValue

class State(TypedDict):
    count: int  # 默认就是 LastValue

# 行为：
# 写入 1 → 读取 1
# 写入 2 → 读取 2（覆盖了 1）

docs.title: EphemeralValue - 临时值
docs.text:
只在当前执行 step 有效，读取后自动清空。

from langgraph.channels import EphemeralValue

class State(TypedDict):
    temp_result: str

graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_channel("temp_result", EphemeralValue(str))

# 使用场景：中间计算结果，不需要持久化
def compute(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"temp_result": "computed"}

def use(state: State) -> dict:
    print(state["temp_result"])  # 可以读取
    return {}

docs.title: Topic - 主题队列
docs.text:
类似消息队列，支持多个值的累积和消费。

from langgraph.channels import Topic
from typing import Annotated

class State(TypedDict):
    # Topic 会自动累积所有写入的值
    events: Annotated[list, Topic(str)]

# 节点 A 写入
def producer(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"events": ["event1", "event2"]}

# 节点 B 读取所有累积的事件
def consumer(state: State) -> dict:
    print(state["events"])  # ["event1", "event2"]
    return {}

docs.title: BinaryOperatorAggregate - 聚合值
docs.text:
使用自定义函数聚合多个写入。

from langgraph.channels import BinaryOperatorAggregate
from typing import Annotated

def sum_reducer(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b

class State(TypedDict):
    total: Annotated[int, BinaryOperatorAggregate(sum_reducer)]

# 多次写入会累加
def add_5(state) -> dict:
    return {"total": 5}

def add_10(state) -> dict:
    return {"total": 10}

# 执行后 total = 5 + 10 = 15

docs.title: 状态归约器（Reducer）
docs.text: 归约器定义如何合并多个更新。

docs.title: 使用 Annotated 定义归约器
docs.text:
from typing import Annotated, List
from langgraph.graph import add_messages

class State(TypedDict):
    # 默认：新值覆盖旧值
    value: int

    # 使用 add_messages 归约器：追加消息
    messages: Annotated[List, add_messages]

docs.title: 自定义归约器
docs.text:
from typing import Annotated, List

def append_reducer(existing: List, new: List) -> List:
    """自定义列表追加归约器"""
    return existing + new

class State(TypedDict):
    items: Annotated[List[str], append_reducer]

# 使用
def add_item(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"items": ["new_item"]}

# 多次调用会累积：["item1", "item2", "new_item"]

docs.title: 内置归约器
docs.text:
from langgraph.graph import add_messages

# add_messages：智能合并消息列表
# - 根据消息 ID 去重
# - 保持消息顺序
# - 处理消息替换

class State(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[List, add_messages]

docs.title: MessagesState - 预定义消息状态
docs.text:
LangGraph 提供了预定义的 MessagesState，专门用于对话场景。

from langgraph.graph import MessagesState, MessageGraph

# 方式 1：使用 MessagesState
class State(MessagesState):
    # 自动包含 messages 字段
    extra_field: str

# 方式 2：直接使用 MessageGraph
graph = MessageGraph()
graph.add_node("agent", agent_fn)
# MessageGraph 自动处理消息状态

docs.title: 获取状态快照
docs.text:
# 运行图并获取检查点
config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": "1"}}
result = app.invoke({"value": 0}, config)

# 获取当前状态快照
snapshot = app.get_state(config)
print(snapshot.values)  # 当前状态
print(snapshot.next)    # 下一个要执行的节点

docs.title: 时间旅行（回到过去的状态）
docs.text:
# 获取历史
history = list(app.get_state_history(config))

# 回到之前的状态
old_state = history[1]  # 倒数第二个状态
app.update_state(config, old_state.values)

# 从那个状态继续执行
result = app.invoke(None, config)

docs.title: 检查点（Checkpointing）
docs.text: 检查点用于持久化状态，支持断点续跑。

docs.title: 使用内存检查点
docs.text:
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import MemorySaver

memory = MemorySaver()
app = graph.compile(checkpointer=memory)

# 使用 thread_id 区分不同会话
config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": "conversation-1"}}
result = app.invoke({"messages": [...]}, config)

docs.title: 使用 SQLite 检查点
docs.text:
pip install langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite

from langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite import SqliteSaver

with SqliteSaver.from_conn_string("checkpoints.sqlite") as saver:
    app = graph.compile(checkpointer=saver)

    config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": "1"}}
    result = app.invoke({"value": 0}, config)

docs.title: 检查点配置
docs.text:
config = {
    "configurable": {
        "thread_id": "user-123",      # 会话 ID
        "checkpoint_ns": "main",      # 命名空间（用于子图）
        "checkpoint_id": "abc123",    # 指定检查点 ID
    }
}

    value: int

    messages: Annotated[List, add_messages]
    tool_calls: List[dict]
    tool_results: List[dict]

docs.text:

    print(f"📍 {config.get('configurable', {}).get('thread_id', 'unknown')}")
    print(f"   状态：{state}")

for node, values in app.stream({"value": 0}):
    print(f"{node}: {values}")

docs.title: ✅ 推荐
docs.text:
# 1. 使用 TypedDict 定义清晰的状态结构
class State(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[List, add_messages]
    iteration: int

# 2. 只返回需要的更新
def node(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"iteration": state["iteration"] + 1}

# 3. 使用 checkpointer 持久化重要状态
app = graph.compile(checkpointer=MemorySaver())

def router(state: State) -> Literal["path_a", "path_b"]:

    source="decision_node",

docs.text:
from typing import Literal
from langchain_core.messages import AIMessage, HumanMessage

class State(TypedDict):
    messages: list

def classify_intent(state: State) -> Literal["support", "sales", "general"]:
    last_message = state["messages"][-1].content

    if "help" in last_message or "problem" in last_message:
        return "support"
    elif "price" in last_message or "buy" in last_message:
        return "sales"
    return "general"

graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("classify", classify_intent)
graph.add_node("support", support_agent)
graph.add_node("sales", sales_agent)
graph.add_node("general", general_agent)

graph.add_edge(START, "classify")
graph.add_conditional_edges("classify", classify_intent)

docs.title: 模式 2：基于工具调用的路由
docs.text:
def route_after_tool(state: State) -> Literal["tool_node", "agent_node", END]:
    messages = state["messages"]
    last_message = messages[-1]

    # 如果有工具调用，去工具节点
    if last_message.tool_calls:
        return "tool_node"

    # 如果有工具结果，回 agent
    if hasattr(last_message, "tool_call_id"):
        return "agent_node"

    # 否则结束
    return END

graph.add_conditional_edges("agent", route_after_tool)

docs.title: 模式 1：固定次数循环
docs.text:
class State(TypedDict):
    value: int
    count: int

def increment(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"value": state["value"] + 1, "count": state["count"] + 1}

def check_limit(state: State) -> Literal["continue", "end"]:
    if state["count"] >= 5:
        return "end"
    return "continue"

graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("increment", increment)
graph.add_conditional_edges("increment", check_limit, {
    "continue": "increment",
    "end": END
})
graph.add_edge(START, "increment")

docs.title: 模式 2：Agent 循环（ReAct 模式）
docs.text:
def should_continue(state: State) -> Literal["tools", END]:
    messages = state["messages"]
    last_message = messages[-1]

    # 如果 AI 要求调用工具，继续
    if last_message.tool_calls:
        return "tools"

    # 否则结束
    return END

graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("agent", agent_function)
graph.add_node("tools", tool_function)

graph.add_edge(START, "agent")
graph.add_edge("tools", "agent")  # 工具执行后回到 agent
graph.add_conditional_edges("agent", should_continue)

graph.add_edge("start", "process_c")

def branch_router(state: State) -> Literal["branch_a", "branch_b", "branch_c"]:
    # 根据条件选择分支
    if condition_a:
        return "branch_a"
    elif condition_b:
        return "branch_b"
    return "branch_c"

graph.add_conditional_edges("decision", branch_router)

# 所有分支汇聚到同一个结束节点
graph.add_edge("branch_a", "end")
graph.add_edge("branch_b", "end")
graph.add_edge("branch_c", "end")

from typing import TypedDict, Annotated, List
from langchain_core.messages import BaseMessage, HumanMessage, AIMessage

docs.title: 子图（Subgraphs）
docs.text: 子图允许你将复杂的图分解为可重用的模块。

docs.title: 创建子图
docs.text:
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END

# 子图的状态
class SubGraphState(TypedDict):
    value: int

# 创建子图
subgraph = StateGraph(SubGraphState)
subgraph.add_node("add_one", lambda s: {"value": s["value"] + 1})
subgraph.add_node("add_two", lambda s: {"value": s["value"] + 2})
subgraph.add_edge(START, "add_one")
subgraph.add_edge("add_one", "add_two")
subgraph.add_edge("add_two", END)

# 编译子图
compiled_subgraph = subgraph.compile()

docs.title: 在主图中使用子图
docs.text:
class MainState(TypedDict):
    value: int

main_graph = StateGraph(MainState)

# 将子图作为节点添加
main_graph.add_node("subgraph", compiled_subgraph)
main_graph.add_edge(START, "subgraph")
main_graph.add_edge("subgraph", END)

app = main_graph.compile()
result = app.invoke({"value": 0})  # value: 0 → 1 → 3

docs.title: 状态映射
docs.text:
# 子图状态和主图状态可能不同
class MainState(TypedDict):
    input_value: int
    output_value: int

class SubState(TypedDict):
    value: int

# 需要在进入和离开子图时转换状态
def to_subgraph_state(state: MainState) -> SubState:
    return {"value": state["input_value"]}

def from_subgraph_state(sub_result: SubState) -> MainState:
    return {"output_value": sub_result["value"]}

docs.title: 人工审核模式
docs.text:
class State(TypedDict):
    draft: str
    approved: bool

def generate_draft(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"draft": "AI generated content"}

def human_review(state: State) -> dict:
    # 这个节点会等待人工输入
    print(f"请审核：{state['draft']}")
    # 实际应用中，这里会等待用户输入
    return {"approved": True}

graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("generate", generate_draft)
graph.add_node("review", human_review)
graph.add_edge(START, "generate")
graph.add_edge("generate", "review")
graph.add_edge("review", END)

# 在 review 前中断，等待人工审核
app = graph.compile(
    checkpointer=memory,
    interrupt_before=["review"]
)

# 第一次运行：生成草稿后停止
app.invoke({}, config)

# 人工审核后，更新状态并继续
app.update_state(config, {"approved": True})
app.invoke(None, config)

from langgraph.types import Command

def conditional_node(state: State) -> Command:
    if state["value"] > 10:
        return Command(
            goto="high_path",
            update={"value": state["value"] * 2}
        )
    else:
        return Command(
            goto="low_path",
            update={"value": state["value"] + 1}

from langgraph.func import task

@task
def process(data: dict) -> dict:
    return {"processed": data}

@task
def transform(data: dict) -> dict:
    return {"transformed": data}

@entrypoint
def workflow(input: dict) -> dict:
    p = process(input)
    t = transform(p)
    return t

docs.title: 示例 1：简单的对话机器人
docs.text:
from typing import TypedDict, Annotated, List
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, AIMessage
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END, add_messages
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import MemorySaver

# 1. 定义状态
class State(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[List, add_messages]

# 2. 初始化模型
model = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4")

# 3. 定义节点
def chatbot(state: State) -> dict:
    response = model.invoke(state["messages"])
    return {"messages": [response]}

# 4. 构建图
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("chatbot", chatbot)
graph.add_edge(START, "chatbot")
graph.add_edge("chatbot", END)

# 5. 编译（带记忆）
memory = MemorySaver()
app = graph.compile(checkpointer=memory)

# 6. 使用
config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": "conversation-1"}}

# 第一轮
result = app.invoke({"messages": [HumanMessage(content="你好！")]}, config)
print(result["messages"][-1].content)

# 第二轮（记住上下文）

docs.title: 示例 2：带工具调用的 Agent
docs.text:
from typing import TypedDict, Annotated, List, Literal
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.tools import tool
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, AIMessage, ToolMessage
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END, add_messages
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import MemorySaver

# 1. 定义工具
@tool
def search_web(query: str) -> str:
    """搜索网络获取信息"""
    return f"搜索结果：{query}"

@tool
def calculate(expression: str) -> str:
    """计算数学表达式"""
    return f"计算结果：{expression}"

tools = [search_web, calculate]

# 2. 绑定工具到模型
model = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4")
model_with_tools = model.bind_tools(tools)

# 3. 定义状态
class State(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[List, add_messages]

# 4. 定义节点
def agent(state: State) -> dict:
    response = model_with_tools.invoke(state["messages"])
    return {"messages": [response]}

def tools_node(state: State) -> dict:
    tool_calls = state["messages"][-1].tool_calls
    results = []

    for call in tool_calls:
        tool_name = call["name"]
        tool_input = call["args"]

        for t in tools:
            if t.name == tool_name:
                result = t.invoke(tool_input)
                results.append(ToolMessage(
                    content=str(result),
                    tool_call_id=call["id"]
                ))

    return {"messages": results}

# 5. 定义路由
def should_continue(state: State) -> Literal["tools", END]:
    messages = state["messages"]
    last_message = messages[-1]

    if last_message.tool_calls:
        return "tools"
    return END

# 6. 构建图
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("agent", agent)
graph.add_node("tools", tools_node)

graph.add_edge(START, "agent")
graph.add_conditional_edges("agent", should_continue)
graph.add_edge("tools", "agent")  # 工具执行后回到 agent

# 7. 编译
memory = MemorySaver()
app = graph.compile(checkpointer=memory)

# 8. 使用
config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": "agent-1"}}

result = app.invoke({
    "messages": [HumanMessage(content="帮我搜索一下 Python 的最新版本")]
}, config)

print(result["messages"][-1].content)

from typing import TypedDict, Annotated, List, Literal
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, AIMessage
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END, add_messages
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import MemorySaver

class State(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[List, add_messages]
    draft: str
    approved: bool

model = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4")

def generate_draft(state: State) -> dict:
    prompt = f"请为以下内容生成回复草稿：{state['messages'][-1].content}"
    response = model.invoke([HumanMessage(content=prompt)])
    return {"draft": response.content}

def human_review(state: State) -> dict:
    # 实际应用中，这里会等待用户输入
    print(f"\n=== 草稿 ===")
    print(state["draft"])
    print(f"==============\n")

    # 模拟人工审核（实际应该等待用户输入）
    approved = input("是否批准？(y/n): ").lower() == 'y'
    return {"approved": approved}

def send_response(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"messages": [AIMessage(content=state["draft"])]}

def reject(state: State) -> dict:
    return {"messages": [AIMessage(content="抱歉，我需要重新考虑这个回答。")]}

def route_after_review(state: State) -> Literal["send", "reject"]:
    return "send" if state["approved"] else "reject"

# 构建图
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("generate", generate_draft)
graph.add_node("review", human_review)
graph.add_node("send", send_response)
graph.add_node("reject", reject)

graph.add_edge(START, "generate")
graph.add_edge("generate", "review")
graph.add_conditional_edges("review", route_after_review)
graph.add_edge("send", END)
graph.add_edge("reject", END)

# 在 review 前中断，等待人工输入
memory = MemorySaver()
app = graph.compile(checkpointer=memory, interrupt_before=["review"])

# 使用
config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": "review-1"}}

# 第一步：生成草稿
app.invoke({
    "messages": [HumanMessage(content="写一封感谢邮件")]
}, config)

# 查看草稿
snapshot = app.get_state(config)
print(f"草稿：{snapshot.values['draft']}")

# 人工审核后继续
app.update_state(config, {"approved": True})
result = app.invoke(None, config)

from typing import TypedDict, Annotated, List, Literal
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, AIMessage
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END, add_messages

class State(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[List, add_messages]
    current_agent: str

# 不同角色的 Agent
researcher = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4", system_message="你是研究员，负责查找和分析信息")
writer = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4", system_message="你是作家，负责撰写内容")
reviewer = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4", system_message="你是审核员，负责检查和改进内容")

def researcher_node(state: State) -> dict:
    response = researcher.invoke(state["messages"])
    return {"messages": [response], "current_agent": "writer"}

def writer_node(state: State) -> dict:
    response = writer.invoke(state["messages"])
    return {"messages": [response], "current_agent": "reviewer"}

def reviewer_node(state: State) -> dict:
    response = reviewer.invoke(state["messages"])
    content = response.content

    # 如果需要修改
    if "需要修改" in content:
        return {"messages": [response], "current_agent": "writer"}

    return {"messages": [response], "current_agent": END}

def route(state: State) -> Literal["researcher", "writer", "reviewer", END]:
    if state["current_agent"] == "researcher":
        return "researcher"
    elif state["current_agent"] == "writer":
        return "writer"
    elif state["current_agent"] == "reviewer":
        return "reviewer"
    return END

# 构建图
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("researcher", researcher_node)
graph.add_node("writer", writer_node)
graph.add_node("reviewer", reviewer_node)

graph.add_edge(START, "researcher")
graph.add_conditional_edges("researcher", lambda s: "writer")
graph.add_conditional_edges("writer", lambda s: "reviewer")
graph.add_conditional_edges("reviewer", route)

app = graph.compile()

# 使用
result = app.invoke({
    "messages": [HumanMessage(content="写一篇关于 AI 的短文")],
    "current_agent": "researcher"
})

for msg in result["messages"]:
    print(f"{msg.type}: {msg.content[:100]}...")

docs.text:
from typing import TypedDict, List
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END

class State(TypedDict):
    input_data: str
    cleaned_data: str
    analyzed_data: dict
    report: str

def clean_data(state: State) -> dict:
    # 数据清洗
    cleaned = state["input_data"].strip().lower()
    return {"cleaned_data": cleaned}

def analyze_data(state: State) -> dict:
    # 数据分析
    data = state["cleaned_data"]
    analysis = {
        "length": len(data),
        "word_count": len(data.split()),
        "has_error": "error" in data
    }
    return {"analyzed_data": analysis}

def generate_report(state: State) -> dict:
    # 生成报告
    analysis = state["analyzed_data"]
    report = f"""
    数据分析报告
    ==========
    字符数：{analysis['length']}
    单词数：{analysis['word_count']}
    包含错误：{analysis['has_error']}
    """
    return {"report": report}

# 构建线性工作流
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("clean", clean_data)
graph.add_node("analyze", analyze_data)
graph.add_node("report", generate_report)

graph.add_edge(START, "clean")
graph.add_edge("clean", "analyze")
graph.add_edge("analyze", "report")
graph.add_edge("report", END)

app = graph.compile()

# 使用
result = app.invoke({
    "input_data": "  Hello World, this is a TEST with ERROR handling  "
})

print(result["report"])

from typing import TypedDict, List
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END
import time

class State(TypedDict):
    items: List[str]
    results_a: List[str]
    results_b: List[str]
    results_c: List[str]
    final_result: str

def process_a(state: State) -> dict:
    time.sleep(1)  # 模拟耗时操作
    results = [f"A:{item}" for item in state["items"]]
    return {"results_a": results}

def process_b(state: State) -> dict:
    time.sleep(1)
    results = [f"B:{item}" for item in state["items"]]
    return {"results_b": results}

def process_c(state: State) -> dict:
    time.sleep(1)
    results = [f"C:{item}" for item in state["items"]]
    return {"results_c": results}

def merge_results(state: State) -> dict:
    merged = list(zip(state["results_a"], state["results_b"], state["results_c"]))
    return {"final_result": str(merged)}

# 构建图
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("process_a", process_a)
graph.add_node("process_b", process_b)
graph.add_node("process_c", process_c)
graph.add_node("merge", merge_results)

# 扇出：start 同时触发三个处理节点
graph.add_edge(START, "process_a")
graph.add_edge(START, "process_b")
graph.add_edge(START, "process_c")

# 扇入：所有处理完成后合并
graph.add_edge("process_a", "merge")
graph.add_edge("process_b", "merge")
graph.add_edge("process_c", "merge")
graph.add_edge("merge", END)

app = graph.compile()

# 使用
result = app.invoke({"items": ["item1", "item2", "item3"]})
print(result["final_result"])

docs.text:
from typing import TypedDict, Annotated, List, Literal
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI, OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage, AIMessage
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, START, END, add_messages

class State(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[List, add_messages]
    question: str
    context: str
    answer: str

model = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4")
embeddings = OpenAIEmbeddings()

# 模拟向量数据库
def retrieve_documents(question: str) -> List[str]:
    # 实际应用中这里会查询向量数据库
    return [
        "文档 1: LangGraph 是用于构建有状态应用的库",
        "文档 2: LangGraph 支持循环、分支和并行执行",
        "文档 3: LangGraph 是 LangChain 团队开发的"
    ]

def retrieve(state: State) -> dict:
    question = state["messages"][-1].content
    docs = retrieve_documents(question)
    context = "\n\n".join(docs)
    return {"question": question, "context": context}

def generate(state: State) -> dict:
    prompt = f"""基于以下上下文回答问题：

上下文：
{state['context']}

问题：
{state['question']}

回答："""

    response = model.invoke([HumanMessage(content=prompt)])
    return {"answer": response.content, "messages": [response]}

def should_use_rag(state: State) -> Literal["retrieve", "direct"]:
    # 简单判断：如果问题包含"什么"、"如何"等词，使用 RAG
    question = state["messages"][-1].content
    rag_keywords = ["什么", "如何", "为什么", "怎么", "which", "what", "how"]

    if any(kw in question for kw in rag_keywords):
        return "retrieve"
    return "direct"

def direct_answer(state: State) -> dict:
    response = model.invoke(state["messages"])
    return {"messages": [response]}

# 构建图
graph = StateGraph(State)
graph.add_node("retrieve", retrieve)
graph.add_node("generate", generate)
graph.add_node("direct", direct_answer)

graph.add_edge(START, "retrieve")
graph.add_conditional_edges("retrieve", lambda s: "generate")
graph.add_edge("generate", END)

app = graph.compile()

# 使用
result = app.invoke({
    "messages": [HumanMessage(content="LangGraph 是什么？")]
})

print(result["answer"])

docs.title: 1 vllm介绍
docs.text:
• 官方文档
  • 中文文档

​ vLLM 是一个快速、易于使用的 LLM 推理和服务库。

最初 vLLM 是在加州大学伯克利分校的天空计算实验室 (Sky Computing Lab) 开发的，如今已发展成为一个由学术界和工业界共同贡献的社区驱动项目。

vLLM 具有以下功能：

  • 最先进的服务吞吐量
  • 使用 PagedAttention 高效管理注意力键和值的内存
  • 连续批处理传入请求
  • 使用 CUDA/HIP 图实现快速执行模型
  • 量化：GPTQ、AWQ、INT4、INT8 和 FP8
  • 优化 CUDA 内核，包括与 FlashAttention 和 FlashInfer 的集成
  • 推测性解码
  • 分块预填充

vLLM 在以下方面非常灵活且易于使用：

  • 无缝集成流行的 HuggingFace 模型
  • 使用各种解码算法实现高吞吐量服务，包括并行采样、束搜索等
  • 支持张量并行和流水线并行的分布式推理
  • 流式输出
  • OpenAI 兼容 API 服务器
  • 支持 NVIDIA GPU、AMD CPU 和 GPU、Intel CPU 和 GPU、PowerPC CPU、TPU 以及 AWS Neuron
  • 前缀缓存支持
  • 多 LoRA 支持

欲了解更多信息，请参阅以下内容：

  • vLLM announcing blog post (PagedAttention 教程)
  • vLLM paper (SOSP 2023)
  • How continuous batching enables 23x throughput in LLM inference while reducing p50 latency by Cade Daniel et al.
  • vLLM 会议

docs.title: 0 模型推理介绍
docs.text: 大模型推理（Large Language Model Inference）是指将训练好的大语言模型用于实际生成文本的过程。这个过程不是“一键输出”，而是由多个关键阶段协同完成的，每个阶段都有其特定任务和性能特征。

docs.title: 🧩 大模型推理的三大核心阶段
docs.text:
大模型推理主要分为三个阶段：

阶段 名称 关键作用 1️⃣ Prefill（预填充） 处理用户输入 prompt，构建上下文和 KV Cache 2️⃣ Decoding / Generation（解码/生成） 自回归地逐个生成输出 token（推流的核心） 3️⃣ Post-processing（后处理） 清理输出、截断、格式化、返回结果

下面我们详细展开。

docs.title: 1️⃣ Prefill 阶段：理解你的问题
✅ 做了什么？
docs.text:
• 输入用户的 prompt（如：“请写一首关于春天的诗”）
  • 将 prompt 分词（tokenize）为 token 序列
  • 通过 Transformer 的所有层进行前向传播
  • 计算并缓存每个 token 的 Key 和 Value 向量（KV Cache）

docs.title: 🔍 特点：
docs.text:
• 并行计算：所有 prompt tokens 可以同时处理，GPU 利用率高
  • 耗时与 prompt 长度成正比：输入越长，prefill 时间越久
  • 不产生输出文本，但为后续生成打基础

docs.title: 📈 性能指标：
docs.text:
• TTFT（Time to First Token）：从请求开始到第一个输出 token 的时间，受 prefill 影响最大

💡 优化手段：FlashAttention、PagedAttention、模型量化等

docs.title: 2️⃣ Decoding / Generation 阶段：一个字一个字地“写答案”
docs.text: 这是最核心的生成阶段，也是我们看到“文字一个个蹦出来”的原因。

docs.title: ✅ 做了什么？
docs.text:
• 每次生成一个 token（自回归）
  • 使用 KV Cache 避免重复计算历史信息
  • 重复以下步骤直到结束：
  • 输入当前上下文（prompt + 已生成内容）
  • 模型预测下一个 token 的概率分布
  • 采样（如 greedy、top-p 等）选择 token
  • 返回该 token（如果是流式）
  • 更新 KV Cache
  • 继续下一轮

docs.title: 🔁 示例流程：
docs.text:
输入: "你好"
→ 生成: "，"
→ 生成: "今"
→ 生成: "天"
→ ...

docs.title: 🔍 特点：
docs.text:
• 串行为主：每次只能生成一个 token，无法完全并行
  • 延迟累积：输出越长，总时间越久
  • 支持流式输出（Streaming）：每生成一个 token 就推送给客户端

docs.title: 📈 性能指标：
docs.text:
• TPOT（Time Per Output Token）：每个输出 token 的平均耗时
  • 吞吐量（Tokens/sec）：衡量 GPU 解码效率

💡 优化手段：连续批处理（Continuous Batching）、推测解码（Speculative Decoding）

docs.title: 3️⃣ Post-processing 阶段：整理输出，准备返回
docs.text: 当生成结束（遇到 EOS 标记或达到最大长度），进入后处理阶段。

docs.title: ✅ 做了什么？
docs.text:
• 去除特殊标记（如 </s>）
  • 截断多余内容（如重复、乱码）
  • 统计信息收集（生成长度、耗时、token 数等）
  • 构造最终响应 JSON 或 SSE 流
  • 释放 KV Cache 和显存资源

docs.title: 📝 输出示例（OpenAI API 兼容格式）：
docs.text:
{
  "id": "cmpl-123",
  "object": "text_completion",
  "model": "qwen3-vl-2b",
  "choices": [
    {
      "text": "春天来了，花儿开了...",
      "finish_reason": "length"
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 10,
    "completion_tokens": 50,
    "total_tokens": 60
  }
}

docs.title: 🔄 整体流程图
docs.text:
[用户请求]
     ↓
  Prefill 阶段  ← 处理 prompt，生成 KV Cache
     ↓
Decoding 阶段  ← 自回归生成 token（可流式推送）
     ↓
Post-processing ← 清理输出，构造响应
     ↓
[返回客户端]

docs.title: 🚀 推理引擎如何提升效率？（以 vLLM 为例）
docs.text:
你之前使用的 vLLM 正是通过以下技术优化这三个阶段：

技术 作用 PagedAttention 将 KV Cache 分页管理，显存利用率提升 3-5 倍 Continuous Batching 动态合并多个请求的 decoding 阶段，提高 GPU 利用率 Chunked Prefill 支持超长 prompt 分块处理，边 prefill 边 streaming GPU Memory Utilization 控制 防止 OOM，合理分配显存

⚙️ 例如你命令中的参数： 

--gpu-memory-utilization=0.85
--tensor-parallel-size 1
--max-model-len 2000
都是在配置推理阶段的资源使用策略。

docs.title: 📊 不同场景下的瓶颈分析
docs.text: 场景 主要瓶颈 短 prompt + 长输出（如写作） Decoding 阶段（TPOT 高） 超长文档输入（如摘要） Prefill 阶段（TTFT 高） 高并发聊天服务 显存 + KV Cache 管理 实时语音交互 首字延迟（TTFT）必须低

docs.title: ✅ 总结：三大阶段对比表
docs.text: 阶段 并行性 耗时因素 优化重点 是否流式 Prefill ✅ 高（并行） prompt 长度 FlashAttention, KV Cache ❌ Decoding ❌ 低（串行） 输出长度 连续批处理, 推测解码 ✅ 支持流式 Post-process ✅ 快速 固定开销 格式化、统计、释放资源 -

docs.title: 💬 类比理解
docs.text:
你可以把大模型推理想象成一位作家写作：

  1. Prefill → 作家认真读完你给的题目和背景材料（花时间理解）
  2. Decoding → 作家一个字一个字写下答案（边想边写）
  3. Post-processing → 检查错别字、排版、提交稿件

如果你正在部署模型（如 Qwen、Llama 等），了解这些阶段有助于你： - 调优参数（如 max_model_len、gpu_memory_utilization） - 选择合适的推理框架（vLLM vs TGI vs llama.cpp） - 优化用户体验（降低首字延迟、支持流式）

需要我根据你的具体模型和硬件给出优化建议吗？欢迎继续提问！

docs.title: 一、张量并行
docs.text:
张量并行（tensor_parallel_size选项）可以将模型拆分到多个 GPU 上。

以下代码将模型拆分到 2 个 GPU 上。 python llm = LLM(model="ibm-granite/granite-3.1-8b-instruct", tensor_parallel_size=2)

docs.title: 二、量化
docs.text:
量化模型以降低精度为代价占用更少的内存。静态量化模型可以从 HF Hub 下载（一些流行的模型可在 Neural Magic 找到），并直接使用而无需额外配置。

动态量化也通过 quantization 选项支持——更多详细信息请参阅此处。
https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/features/quantization/index.html#quantization-index

docs.title: 三、上下文长度和批量大小
docs.text:
可以通过限制模型的上下文长度（max_model_len 选项）和最大批量大小（max_num_seqs 选项）来进一步减少内存使用。

python llm = LLM(model="adept/fuyu-8b", max_model_len=2048, max_num_seqs=2)

docs.title: 四、调整缓存大小
docs.text: 如果您的 CPU RAM 不足，请尝试以下选项： （仅限多模态模型）您可以使用环境变量（默认为 4 GiB）设置多模态输入缓存的大小 VLLM_MM_INPUT_CACHE_GIB。 （仅限 CPU 后端）您可以使用环境变量（默认 4 GiB）VLLM_CPU_KVCACHE_SPACE 设置 KV 缓存的大小。

docs.title: 五、性能优化和调优
docs.text: 您可以通过微调各种选项来潜在地提高 vLLM 的性能。更多详细信息请参阅 https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/optimization.html#optimization-and-tuning

• 引擎参数-中文地址

以下是启动 vLLM 服务器时常用的一些参数：

--model：要使用的 HuggingFace 模型名称或路径（默认值：facebook/opt-125m）。

--host 和 --port：指定服务器地址和端口。

docs.title: 二分查找模板
docs.text:
def binary_search(arr, target):
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while left <= right:
        mid = left + (right - left) // 2
        if arr[mid] == target:
            return mid
        elif arr[mid] < target:
            left = mid + 1
        else:
            right = mid - 1
    return -1

docs.title: DFS 模板
docs.text:
def dfs(graph, node, visited):
    visited.add(node)
    for neighbor in graph[node]:
        if neighbor not in visited:
            dfs(graph, neighbor, visited)

docs.title: BFS 模板
docs.text:
from collections import deque

def bfs(graph, start):
    visited = {start}
    queue = deque([start])
    while queue:
        node = queue.popleft()
        for neighbor in graph[node]:
            if neighbor not in visited:
                visited.add(neighbor)
                queue.append(neighbor)

def backtrack(path, choices):
    if is_done(path):
        result.append(path[:])
        return

    for choice in choices:
        if not is_valid(choice):
            continue

        path.append(choice)
        backtrack(path, new_choices)
        path.pop()

docs.title: 1. 概述
docs.text: 动态规划是一种将复杂问题分解为更小子问题的优化方法。

docs.title: 核心思想
docs.text:
• 分治思想：大问题 → 小问题
  • 记忆化：保存已计算的结果，避免重复计算
  • 状态转移：从小问题推导大问题
动态规划 vs 递归 vs 分治

递归：自顶向下，可能有重复计算
    f(5)
   /    \
 f(4)   f(3)
 /  \   /  \
f(3) f(2) ...  ← f(3) 重复计算！

动态规划：自底向上或记忆化，无重复
    f(5)
      ↑
    f(4)
      ↑
    f(3) ← 只计算一次
      ↑
    f(2)

docs.title: 适用场景
docs.text: ✅ 最优子结构：大问题的最优解包含子问题的最优解 ✅ 重叠子问题：子问题会被重复计算 ✅ 无后效性：未来与过去无关，只与现在有关

docs.title: 2. DP 解题步骤 ⭐⭐⭐
docs.text:
步骤 1：定义状态（dp 数组的含义）
步骤 2：确定状态转移方程
步骤 3：初始化边界条件
步骤 4：确定遍历顺序
步骤 5：举例推导 dp 数组

docs.text:
# 问题：每次可以爬 1 或 2 阶，爬到 n 阶有多少种方法？

# 步骤 1：定义状态
# dp[i] = 爬到第 i 阶的方法数

# 步骤 2：状态转移方程
# dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-2]
# 最后一步可以是爬 1 阶或 2 阶

# 步骤 3：初始化
# dp[0] = 1（地面）
# dp[1] = 1（1 阶）

# 步骤 4：遍历顺序
# 从前往后

# 步骤 5：推导
# dp[0]=1, dp[1]=1, dp[2]=2, dp[3]=3, dp[4]=5...

def climbStairs(n: int) -> int:
    if n <= 1:
        return 1

    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 1
    dp[1] = 1

    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        dp[i] = dp[i - 1] + dp[i - 2]

    return dp[n]


# 空间优化（只需要前两个状态）
def climbStairs_optimized(n: int) -> int:
    if n <= 1:
        return 1

    prev2, prev1 = 1, 1
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        curr = prev1 + prev2
        prev2 = prev1
        prev1 = curr

    return prev1

def fib(n: int) -> int:
    """
    LeetCode 509：斐波那契数列

    F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1
    F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)
    """
    if n <= 1:
        return n

    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 0
    dp[1] = 1

    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        dp[i] = dp[i - 1] + dp[i - 2]

    return dp[n]


# 空间优化版
def fib_optimized(n: int) -> int:
    if n <= 1:
        return n

    prev2, prev1 = 0, 1
    for _ in range(2, n + 1):
        curr = prev1 + prev2
        prev2 = prev1
        prev1 = curr

    return prev1

docs.text:
def minPathSum(grid: List[List[int]]) -> int:
    """
    LeetCode 64：最小路径和

    从左上到右下，每次只能向下或向右
    求路径上数字和的最小值
    """
    m, n = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # dp[i][j] = 到达 (i,j) 的最小路径和
    dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(m)]

    # 初始化
    dp[0][0] = grid[0][0]

    # 第一行（只能从左边来）
    for j in range(1, n):
        dp[0][j] = dp[0][j - 1] + grid[0][j]

    # 第一列（只能从上面来）
    for i in range(1, m):
        dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] + grid[i][0]

    # 填充其余位置
    for i in range(1, m):
        for j in range(1, n):
            dp[i][j] = min(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]) + grid[i][j]

    return dp[m - 1][n - 1]


# 空间优化（只需要一行）
def minPathSum_optimized(grid: List[List[int]]) -> int:
    m, n = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    dp = [0] * n

    dp[0] = grid[0][0]
    for j in range(1, n):
        dp[j] = dp[j - 1] + grid[0][j]

    for i in range(1, m):
        dp[0] += grid[i][0]
        for j in range(1, n):
            dp[j] = min(dp[j], dp[j - 1]) + grid[i][j]

    return dp[n - 1]

docs.text:
def uniquePaths(m: int, n: int) -> int:
    """
    LeetCode 62：不同路径

    从左上到右下，每次只能向下或向右
    求有多少种不同路径
    """
    # dp[i][j] = 到达 (i,j) 的路径数
    dp = [[1] * n for _ in range(m)]

    for i in range(1, m):
        for j in range(1, n):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] + dp[i][j - 1]

    return dp[m - 1][n - 1]


# 空间优化
def uniquePaths_optimized(m: int, n: int) -> int:
    dp = [1] * n

    for _ in range(1, m):
        for j in range(1, n):
            dp[j] += dp[j - 1]

    return dp[n - 1]

docs.title: 4.1 0-1 背包
docs.text:
def knapsack_01(weights: List[int], values: List[int], capacity: int) -> int:
    """
    0-1 背包问题

    n 个物品，每个重量 weight[i]，价值 value[i]
    背包容量 capacity，求最大价值
    每个物品只能选 0 次或 1 次

    dp[i][j] = 前 i 个物品，容量为 j 时的最大价值
    """
    n = len(weights)
    dp = [[0] * (capacity + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(capacity + 1):
            # 不选第 i 个物品
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j]

            # 选第 i 个物品（如果容量够）
            if j >= weights[i - 1]:
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], 
                              dp[i - 1][j - weights[i - 1]] + values[i - 1])

    return dp[n][capacity]


# 空间优化（一维数组，倒序遍历）
def knapsack_01_optimized(weights: List[int], values: List[int], capacity: int) -> int:
    n = len(weights)
    dp = [0] * (capacity + 1)

    for i in range(n):
        # 倒序遍历（避免重复使用同一物品）
        for j in range(capacity, weights[i] - 1, -1):
            dp[j] = max(dp[j], dp[j - weights[i]] + values[i])

    return dp[capacity]


# 示例
weights = [2, 3, 4, 5]
values = [3, 4, 5, 6]
capacity = 8
print(knapsack_01(weights, values, capacity))  # 10

0-1 背包关键点：
- 倒序遍历容量：保证每个物品只用一次
- 状态转移：dp[j] = max(dp[j], dp[j-w] + v)

docs.title: 4.2 完全背包
docs.text:
def knapsack_complete(weights: List[int], values: List[int], capacity: int) -> int:
    """
    完全背包问题

    每个物品可以选无限次

    关键：正序遍历容量（允许重复使用）
    """
    n = len(weights)
    dp = [0] * (capacity + 1)

    for i in range(n):
        # 正序遍历（可以重复使用）
        for j in range(weights[i], capacity + 1):
            dp[j] = max(dp[j], dp[j - weights[i]] + values[i])

    return dp[capacity]


# 示例（零钱兑换问题）
def coinChange(coins: List[int], amount: int) -> int:
    """
    LeetCode 322：零钱兑换

    完全背包应用
    求凑成金额的最少硬币数
    """
    INF = float('inf')
    dp = [INF] * (amount + 1)
    dp[0] = 0

    for coin in coins:
        for j in range(coin, amount + 1):
            dp[j] = min(dp[j], dp[j - coin] + 1)

    return dp[amount] if dp[amount] != INF else -1


# 示例
coins = [1, 2, 5]
amount = 11
print(coinChange(coins, amount))  # 3 (5+5+1)

docs.text:
def combinationSum4(nums: List[int], target: int) -> int:
    """
    LeetCode 377：组合总和 IV

    求排列数（考虑顺序）

    关键：外层遍历容量，内层遍历物品
    """
    dp = [0] * (target + 1)
    dp[0] = 1

    # 外层容量，内层物品 → 排列数
    for j in range(1, target + 1):
        for num in nums:
            if j >= num:
                dp[j] += dp[j - num]

    return dp[target]


# 对比：求组合数（不考虑顺序）
# 外层物品，内层容量 → 组合数

docs.title: 5.1 最长递增子序列（LIS）
docs.text:
def lengthOfLIS(nums: List[int]) -> int:
    """
    LeetCode 300：最长递增子序列

    dp[i] = 以 nums[i] 结尾的最长递增子序列长度
    """
    if not nums:
        return 0

    n = len(nums)
    dp = [1] * n

    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(i):
            if nums[j] < nums[i]:
                dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1)

    return max(dp)


# 贪心 + 二分优化 O(n log n)
def lengthOfLIS_optimized(nums: List[int]) -> int:
    tails = []

    for num in nums:
        # 二分查找第一个 >= num 的位置
        left, right = 0, len(tails)
        while left < right:
            mid = (left + right) // 2
            if tails[mid] < num:
                left = mid + 1
            else:
                right = mid

        if left == len(tails):
            tails.append(num)
        else:
            tails[left] = num

    return len(tails)


# 示例
nums = [10, 9, 2, 5, 3, 7, 101, 18]
print(lengthOfLIS(nums))  # 4 ([2, 3, 7, 18])

docs.title: 5.2 最长公共子序列（LCS）
docs.text:
def longestCommonSubsequence(text1: str, text2: str) -> int:
    """
    LeetCode 1143：最长公共子序列

    dp[i][j] = text1[:i] 和 text2[:j] 的 LCS 长度
    """
    m, n = len(text1), len(text2)
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]

    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            if text1[i - 1] == text2[j - 1]:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
            else:
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])

    return dp[m][n]


# 示例
text1 = "abcde"
text2 = "ace"
print(longestCommonSubsequence(text1, text2))  # 3 ("ace")

docs.title: 5.3 最长回文子序列
docs.text:
def longestPalindromeSubseq(s: str) -> int:
    """
    LeetCode 516：最长回文子序列

    dp[i][j] = s[i:j+1] 的最长回文子序列长度
    """
    n = len(s)
    dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]

    # 单个字符都是回文
    for i in range(n):
        dp[i][i] = 1

    # 从下往上，从左往右
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if s[i] == s[j]:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i + 1][j - 1] + 2
            else:
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i + 1][j], dp[i][j - 1])

    return dp[0][n - 1]


# 示例
s = "bbbab"
print(longestPalindromeSubseq(s))  # 4 ("bbbb")

docs.title: 6.1 矩阵链乘法
docs.text:
def matrixChainOrder(p: List[int]) -> int:
    """
    矩阵链乘法

    p = [30, 35, 15, 5, 10, 20, 25]
    表示矩阵：A1(30×35), A2(35×15), A3(15×5), A4(5×10), A5(10×20), A6(20×25)

    求最小标量乘法次数
    """
    n = len(p) - 1
    dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]

    # length = 链长度
    for length in range(2, n + 1):
        for i in range(n - length + 1):
            j = i + length - 1
            dp[i][j] = float('inf')

            for k in range(i, j):
                cost = dp[i][k] + dp[k + 1][j] + p[i] * p[k + 1] * p[j + 1]
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], cost)

    return dp[0][n - 1]
